name: markbridge

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-math-assets.cjs && esbuild src/kernel.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=MBB --external:@wordpress/latex-to-mathml --outfile=plugin/kernel.js && esbuild src/emoji.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=plugin/emoji.js && node scripts/build-ui-assets.cjs && node scripts/build-runtime-contract.cjs
scripts.test: node tests/kernel.cjs && node tests/r10-04.cjs && node tests/task-lists.cjs && node tests/footnotes.cjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && python3 scripts/check_release.py

description: Markdown and WordPress blocks, kept together.
